companies.name: Genuport Trade GmbH
companies.distributes: Imported branded confectionery, biscuits, snacks, cereals and sports nutrition from almost 30 countries, about 50 brands including Cadbury, Weetabix, Fazer, Reese's and Rocky Mountain.
companies.channels_supplied: German food retail nationally (LEH) including Edeka and Rewe online shops, Amazon, fitness studios and its own B2C shop veritastii.de. Berlin coverage is through national retail, not a named Berlin account.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Multipower, Grenade and Oatsnack (protein and fitness lines); no sugar-free confectionery brand named.
companies.fit_rationale: Family-owned specialist importer whose whole business is bringing foreign confectionery and snack brands into German retail, with British brands already in the portfolio. A sugar-free chocolate and biscuits range would fill a gap next to its fitness lines without a direct competitor.
what_they_do_well: Family business trading since 1949, about 160 staff and roughly 130 million euros revenue in 2025.
Runs its own field sales force of about 60 people.

companies.name: Lekkerland
companies.distributes: Convenience wholesale range of confectionery, snacks, drinks, tobacco and food to go.
companies.channels_supplied: Petrol station shops, kiosks, convenience stores, bakeries, grocery retailers and quick service restaurants; Berlin kiosks and petrol stations sit within its national coverage, not confirmed by a Berlin-specific source.
companies.fit_rationale: Berlin's late shops (Spätis), kiosks and petrol stations are a large impulse confectionery channel and Lekkerland is the leading wholesaler to it. Fully owned by the REWE Group since 2019 but still trades as Lekkerland, so listing decisions are central and harder to reach than an owner-run importer.
what_they_do_well: Supplies about 91,000 sales points across seven European countries, per its 2019 profile.

companies.name: Uplegger Food Company GmbH
companies.distributes: Imported and distributed branded food, mainly chilled, including British brands such as Gu desserts and Cathedral City cheese; directory listing also covers confectionery and snacks and organic and health food.
companies.channels_supplied: German food retail; serves Germany, Austria, the Netherlands and Switzerland. Named retail accounts not confirmed.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Green goes Fresh and The Vegetarian Butcher (plant-based); no sugar-free confectionery confirmed.
companies.fit_rationale: Long-standing importer of British brands into German retail, which matches Diablo's UK exporting entity. Its focus is chilled, so ambient confectionery may need a separate conversation; the extent to which it buys and holds stock versus providing sales services should be checked.
what_they_do_well: Has built British brands such as Cathedral City and Gu in German retail.

companies.name: Terra Naturkost Handels KG
companies.distributes: Full range organic and vegan groceries, including sweets and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: About 1,200 organic supermarkets, health food shops, restaurants, cafes, canteens and nurseries in Berlin, Brandenburg, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and parts of Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt; sister company of the Bio Company chain within Bioverbund SE.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest Berlin-based wholesaler to health-oriented independent retail, owner-managed since 1987. Its range is organic, so it fits only if Diablo lines meet organic or natural-store listing criteria, which is why it sits in tier 2.
what_they_do_well: Founded in Berlin in 1981 and now one of Germany's three largest organic wholesalers.
Runs its own fleet of 50 lorries from a central Berlin site.

companies.name: Transgourmet Deutschland (Selgros Cash & Carry)
companies.distributes: Cash and carry and delivery wholesale of food and non-food, about 68,000 items including confectionery and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Selgros markets in Berlin Lichtenberg, Ahrensfelde, Falkensee, Stahnsdorf and Cottbus serving retailers, kiosks, hotels and gastronomy.
companies.fit_rationale: Five cash and carry markets in and around Berlin are where many independent shops and Spätis buy confectionery. A large generalist, so a listing is more of a range slot than active brand building.
what_they_do_well: Operates 38 cash and carry markets in Germany and delivers to 32,500 customers.

companies.name: Hamberger Großmarkt
companies.distributes: Cash and carry wholesale with about 46,000 food and 14,000 non-food items, including confectionery.
companies.channels_supplied: Gastronomy and small retailers from its Berlin Moabit market, plus a delivery service.
companies.fit_rationale: Owner-run wholesaler with a large Berlin market serving restaurants and small retailers, a route into Berlin's independent trade. Gastronomy focus makes it secondary for a retail snack range.
what_they_do_well: Opened a Berlin wholesale market in Moabit with about 60,000 items.

companies.name: METRO Deutschland
companies.distributes: Cash and carry wholesale of food and non-food, including confectionery and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Three Berlin markets (Berolina in Spandau, Marienfelde, Friedrichshain) serving gastronomy, kiosks and independent retailers.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest cash and carry network in Germany, with three Berlin markets used by independent retailers and kiosks. Large and centrally bought, so lower priority than specialist importers.

companies.name: Becker Süßwaren GmbH
companies.distributes: Specialist confectionery import and wholesale, more than 4,500 items including traditional sweets.
companies.channels_supplied: Trade customers across northern Germany with same-day delivery; whether Berlin is in its delivery area is not confirmed.
companies.fit_rationale: A specialist confectionery importer and wholesaler is close to the ideal profile. It sits in tier 3 only because Berlin coverage could not be confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Has traded for more than 150 years, according to its directory listing.

companies.name: Americancandy
companies.distributes: Imported American sweets, snacks, cereals and soft drinks.
companies.channels_supplied: Own online store and retail; wholesale to other shops not confirmed.
companies.fit_rationale: Berlin importer of foreign confectionery since 2003 with import know-how. Mainly a retailer, so only a fit if it also wholesales to other shops.

companies.name: dennree GmbH
companies.distributes: Organic food and natural cosmetics wholesale, about 10,000 items.
companies.channels_supplied: More than 1,500 natural food stores in Germany, Austria and Luxembourg plus its own denn's Biomarkt chain; Berlin coverage not confirmed by the source.
companies.fit_rationale: National organic wholesaler with reach into natural food stores. Organic-only range and unconfirmed Berlin service make it conditional.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1974 and supplies more than 1,500 natural food stores.

companies.name: Monolith Gruppe
companies.distributes: Eastern European specialty foods, more than 4,000 items including Russian sweets, drinks, meat and fish.
companies.channels_supplied: About 2,500 trade customers including the Mix Markt store network and food retail; Berlin outlets not confirmed.
companies.fit_rationale: Large importer-wholesaler with its own retail network for Eastern European communities. Range is ethnic, so a British sugar-free brand is an unusual fit.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1997, six German sites and more than 500 staff.

companies.name: IFBI Int'l Food & Beverage Import GmbH
companies.distributes: Imported tea, chai, chocolate, beverages and spices.
companies.fit_rationale: Small Berlin importer that already brings in chocolate for retail and gastronomy. Range and scale need checking before outreach.

companies.name: Öz-Marma Lebensmittelgroßhandel GmbH
companies.distributes: Turkish and Middle Eastern specialty foods wholesale.
companies.channels_supplied: Retail and trade customers in Berlin, Brandenburg, Halle, Leipzig, Dresden, Prague and Warsaw.
companies.fit_rationale: Owner-run Berlin wholesaler supplying the city's many Turkish and Middle Eastern grocers, a dense independent retail channel. Its range is ethnic, so fit depends on appetite for a sugar-free line.
what_they_do_well: Trading and delivering from Berlin since 2007.

companies.name: Löwenzahn Cash & Carry GmbH
companies.distributes: General grocery wholesale including confectionery and snacks, drinks and ethnic food.
companies.fit_rationale: Berlin cash and carry with a listed confectionery and snacks range. Limited public detail on customers and scale.

companies.name: Ada Grosshandel
companies.distributes: Wholesale of confectionery and snacks, ethnic food, fruit and vegetables, spreads and soft drinks.
companies.channels_supplied: Trade customers from the Berlin wholesale market (Beusselstraße), unnamed.
companies.fit_rationale: Wholesaler at the Berlin Großmarkt with a listed confectionery range. Profile is thin and needs checking.

companies.name: Alaska Lebensmittelservice GmbH
companies.distributes: Foodservice wholesale of more than 2,000 items including confectionery and snacks, frozen, fish and meat.
companies.channels_supplied: Gastronomy in Berlin and the surrounding area, from its own logistics centre at the Berlin wholesale market.
companies.fit_rationale: Local foodservice wholesaler that could place snacks with cafes and caterers. Gastronomy focus limits retail reach.

companies.name: BARLU Lebensmittel-Service GmbH
companies.distributes: Foodservice wholesale of fish, meat, produce, frozen food and some confectionery and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Gastronomy customers in Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, Halle and Frankfurt (Oder), with a shop in Berlin Tempelhof.
companies.fit_rationale: Regional foodservice wholesaler next to Berlin with a Tempelhof outlet. Fresh protein focus makes confectionery marginal.
